t: That's right. You should kill that dog, Wigo.
r168765.n: No. I won't kill those who cause no harm to anyone.

t: What?! That pig?! He promised we wouldn't be hurt if we left peacefully! He even showed up himself! What are you, his pet?
r168766.n: Wigo wants me to kill you.

t: It's our business, darling. What matters is, we stay out of your way, and you stay out of ours. We won't harm those who hasn't done us harm. It was different before we left Amarantha, but now... We are our own masters. We will hide our secrets so no one else can hurt us.
r168767.n: Who are you? What are you doing here?

t: Wow, we don't get guests often...
r168768.n: Wow, we don't get guests often...

r168781.n: No, I won't kill you. Wigo is wrong.

t: That's your decision. But we won't strike the first blow.
Ah, I see... It's your decision.
r168783.n: Wigo sent me. He wants you dead.

t: I'm glad you see that. Our brethren seem to have lost their ability to appreciate these things. They are too absorbed in their troubles, worries, and curses... We left and settled here, away from everything that weighs them down. Now we are always happy. They told us this life is no better than death, but the kind of existence some of them lead is much worse than any death.
Come closer. You want to talk?
r168785.n: Come closer. You want to talk?

t: That's... Unusual. Thank you. There's nothing we can do to help you, but we won't forget.
r168790.n: I won't do it. Wigo demands too much. I hope you'll find a way to live in harmony with…

r168791.n: Both you and the Blight will be dealt with. Defend yourselves.

t: So that's why you're here... I thought we'd die for our cause, not because of this tyrant's cruelty. We won't go down without a fight. The Blight will protect us - you'll see it after the first blow you strike.
r168792.n: Wigo wants to get rid of you.

t: We are the worshippers of the Blight! While everyone else is building walls to hide behind, searching for a way to cure it - we welcome it and its spawns as the next stage of evolution. We are not trying to spread it. It does it all by itself. We study it to better understand what it creates... Of course, we became exiles even among our brethren, but no one who truly believes is bothered by it.
r168793.n: What's going on here? Who are you?

t: Have you come to join us?
r168794.n: Have you come to join us?

t: I don't know yet. I'll stay here for now. I have nowhere else to go, and I know these parts well. You should return to your friends and tell them what happened. You clearly hoped the vampires would aid you, and all you have is one vampire at best. Hah.

Well, you survived a difficult fight, and then an attack by demons... But judging by your pale skin, you're talking about something else. You might have been bitten. If that's the case, you'll find out soon. I can't give you any advice. As you can see, I haven't been able to escape the curse myself... Ask someone who knows more on the subject.
r168832.n: I don't feel... so well. Do you know what's wrong?

t: They isolated themselves, closed the doors on the outside world. They are probably plotting something. Wigo's arrogance is justified - he is strong and clever, and with the cloning equipment... I don't think they'll make a move so soon, but in the long term, they can become a serious threat. Although it's not my problem anymore.

Why do you think? You saved me, so I saved you. Honestly, I didn't expect Wigo to go through with it. Things were never easy for us, but at least we acted with honor. Amarantha has changed, and I no longer wish to be a part of this... society. So I don't regret my decision.
r168834.n: Why did you decide to save me?

t: I was watching from the side. I can't oppose Wigo directly - it would be a suicide, so I could only watch. When demons showed up, it changed everything. It was utter chaos, so I managed to take you away... Again. My wings took a hit, though. And you were hurt, too.
I'm trying to provide the city with food. I wouldn't say I enjoy it, but someone has to do it, and I at least have the capacity and competence to take it on.

Public pressure. We've been isolated for a while. I don’t know why, but the locals are becoming more and more hostile to us. I don't think they just up and decided to turn against us for no reason - that doesn't happen...
r168875.n: Why did druids refuse to help you?

t: How do you think that goes? Hunting humans is a taboo, and everything else is infected with the Blight. We are searching for other solutions, but our efforts have been fruitless so far.
r168876.n: Why can't you procure blood yourselves?

t: Oh, we have many problems! We used to be able to buy blood from volunteers - in secret, mind you... We thought we found the best way to go about it: we paid the druids to cleanse blighted animals for us, but there have been difficulties, and they no longer help us... And the old folk are too cautious to work with us in secrecy.
I need time to figure out if this blood is a suitable food source for us. And we need to observe the unicorns as well - to see if these "procedures" affect them in any way.
r168878.n: How is the unicorn blood research going?

t: A vampire's life is a nightmare.
r168879.n: A vampire's life is a nightmare.

t: Yeah right! You are flying to an island full of angry draconids, who are even angrier when you intrude in their home! That’s a far more serious risk of losing an arm, leg or your head than some sixty percent chance that one of you loses your arms using the teleporter. Take it and go.
Did she tell you using it could tear your arm off? Fine, here.
r168884.n: Klavdia told me to take the experimental teleporter away from you.

t: Worries? Alas, quite a lot. Most of all, King Louis de Desirae, head of House de Desirae and de facto ruler of all elves, has House de Doucer in his sights. That’s Prince Dakkar’s father, you should know. Dakkar himself, as you can see, separates Armando’s actions from those of other vampires. But Louis, in his day, confiscated the allod Nocturn from House de Doucer. Now he rules there and, of course, he is very opposed to its former owners’ return. In general, there are many in the League who remember what the vampires did... They themselves know that not everyone is ready to accept them. However, the current vampire leader, Wigo de Doucer, is apparently ready for talks.
r168886.n: And what worries you about this plan?

t: For victory in the Big Game, of course. Our House is graced with many qualities – including diplomacy. Yes, House de Doucer did become vampires... but they remained elves. I think, if they don’t kill anyone, they can certainly find a place among the elves. Perhaps even be cured. I’m talking about those who became vampires against their will... Or those who never became vampires but were arrested and exiled like Roxane and Stephane!
r168887.n: But why do you want that?

t: Hmm. Well, I trust him, which means I trust you. Although, if you think about it, nothing could have happened without you. Thank you for saving Eloise. That really moved us along... So, what do you think of this plan: my mother, Great Mage and the head of our House Antoinette de Delice, wants House de Doucer to return to the ranks of the elf Houses. That means amnesty and an end to persecution.
r168888.n: Hi, Zayan asked me to find out about your plan.

t: Wow, what landscapes I have already managed to draw…
r168889.n: Wow, what landscapes I have already managed to draw…

t:
Good memory. Yes, Ivan Gubarevsky asked me to make him a wife. Anyway, the misfortune only worked in his favor. Today he is quite happy with his frog. Rather, former frog.

As for me – I had to run from the law. It’s a good thing Zayan helped me hide...

Now I’m ready to try one more time, keeping previous mistakes in mind.

Long has it been a dream of my people to tame the Astral and create directly from it. The Astral has been studied for hundreds of years now, but no one has even approached creating life!

However, the appearance of the Well of Souls and its divine energy changes everything! We’re trying to create a new Aoidos and breathe life into dead stone!

However, there is a chance it won’t work this time too! , be ready. Use your weapon if necessary!
r168894.n: You already tried to make a lady out of stone once...

t:
Yes... I have extensive experience in past mistakes and disappointments.

Long has it been a dream of my people to tame the Astral and create directly from it. The Astral has been studied for hundreds of years now, but no one has even approached creating life!

However, the appearance of the Well of Souls and its divine energy changes everything! We’re trying to create a new Aoidos and breathe life into dead stone!

However, there is a chance it won’t work this time too! , be ready. Use your weapon if necessary!

Something could go wrong. Or maybe everything will go wrong!

That’s why we had to find a secluded place... where no one would disturb us, and we wouldn’t cause any harm.

You're here? Good.

We’ll begin the brief.

Our goal is to try to create life. Yes, no more and no less!

To that end, we need: first of all, energy from the Well of Souls... Zayan gave it to me. Second, materials that Zayan gave me but you managed to collect.
I hope no one saw you coming here. This is very very secret business.
r168898.n: I hope no one saw you coming here. This is very very secret business.

t: Yes, Nihaz is my true overlord whose will directs and guides me! Don’t you all serve our Lord as well?
It’s so nice to exist! But... something isn’t right... Wait, tell me – where is Nihaz?
r168904.n: We created you out of astral amber!

t: I feel... amazing. It’s nice to be alive!
r168905.n: Your people call me Stormbringer. Your name is Galathy. How do you feel?

t: Who are you? And who am I? How did I get here? And where is... here?
r168906.n: Who are you? And who am I? How did I get here? And where is... here?

t:
That’s impossible! How could that happen?

We used power directly from the Well of Souls that was collected recently...

Wait, . I think I am beginning to understand... When Kyros took the Well of Souls... He and the mage called the Wanderer were able to do something... something so inconspicuous that it didn't show up until we decided to play Creators! Galathy only openly talks about how the others... are hiding.

But... that doesn't mean... that Cosmos himself... No, that cannot be!

Listen, don't say anything to anyone, except Zayan. No one should know about this!
r168935.n: It seems Galathy is under Nihaz’s influence!

t:
Are you suggesting they can be used as slaves?

Have no fear, Stormbringer, without the energy of the Well of Souls that’s impossible, and it is kept by three of our most trusted. If everything is successful, all that’s left is to make extra magical artifacts, saving the future of our people.
r168936.n: But are you ready for anyone who wants to making Aoidoi?

t:
Greetings, Stormbringer!

With joy we received word from Zayan of what is happening here. You know what I am capable of feeling when it's time for another Aoidos to be born. I always look forward to it, so I can welcome the little one into this world and show them the way.

So I'm here waiting to see a new child of my people. I hope you succeed!
r168937.n: Greetings, Stormbringer! With joy we received word from Zayan of what…

t:
Hmm.

Touching the Soul Shard of another Great Mage had a noticeable effect on me.

At some point, our minds were one... I saw much of what Urd saw, felt his emotions, passions, and desires...

Oh, Urd was very ambitious. Yokka never understood who his pupil really was. He secretly studied forbidden works, traveled across the Hemer Desert looking for Tep’s diaries... Then he murdered his teacher in cold blood.

Sure, we needed Tep here too, but Urd had different plans – he did not seek personal immortality at the cost of many lives, he planned to create his own Empire by overthrowing Nezeb.

An empire of necromancers! What do you think of that?

Anyway, I feel he has gotten stronger. Urd unintentionally passed his memory and power to me. Now I just need to use them for good.
r169052.n: How do you feel after everything in the tower of Galenel?

t:
Our strength grows each minute. We have summoned every corpse we could from Veligrad and its surroundings.

But it's too early to celebrate victory. Veligrad’s resources are cleaned out, and our army is only half as big as it should be. Fortunately, there are still many places where we can get new warriors.
r169053.n: Our strength grows each minute. We have summoned every corpse we could…

t:
I assume they quarreled and went separate ways in the end.

The scroll was torn, and Urd's spirit was freed.

This dark magic... has consequences. His grave was too close to the tower.

Everything went downhill since then and eventually the Orcs and marauders tore the place apart.

But the sisters are still somewhere around here. I dread to imagine what has become of them.
r169107.n: What happened to the three sisters?

t:
It's because of the three sisters hungry for power.

There's so much forbidden magic here... and the temptation was too strong.

Urd was... very powerful. It's hard to say where he learned so many horrible secrets... how he managed to create this Summoner Guild... Perhaps he used Tep's legacy? Or something even more dangerous?

Even though he died by our hands in battle... his spirit continued to live. A part of him remained in his notes. And these foolish girls awakened him. Urd's will was so strong it continued to influence the dead in the ruins of Veligrad. And it grew stronger still.

Perhaps you'd like to see what happened in the Tower that day? I'll show you...
r169117.n: But where did it come from?

t:
You really haven't head anything about him?

After defeating the Demon here on Umoir, Skrakan noticed that something strange was happening on Yazes. Some dark magic connected to the Astral.

He was looking for someone he could send there. And I became that messenger.

I would have failed if I didn't meet the noble Iglez and the enchanter's granddaughter Dinah.  We traveled all over the allod before we uncovered the Great Mage Urd's plans.

After becoming the leader of the Summoner Guild, Urd managed to turn the king of Yazes into a zombie. He had all the power, but Iglez exposed his plans and won the nobles over to his side. The local druids also joined him.

Even though the allies didn't all get along, they succeeded. We gathered our army and approached Yazes. Iglez defeated Urd in a long and hard battle. Of course, I did my part. Nothing would have worked if he hadn't found the shards of the crown that protected its owner against the Astral magic... And it was very difficult to collect the "Three Stars"- the three shards.

So Iglez and Dinah got married, and I returned to Umoir to become an apprentice of Skrakan's and the keeper of the tower that held Urd's scroll.
We did it... Urd's ghost is gone, I can feel it.
r169120.n: We did it... Urd's ghost is gone, I can feel it.

t:
[Dakkar is muttering something, trying to warn you. He says something about a scroll. He's about to pass out, he's feeling worse.

With great difficulty, he moves his hand to give you something.

It's the Dead Bone Horn.]
r169185.n: Dakkar! What's going on? How do we free you?

t:
The soul sphere attracts local ghosts, consumes them and transfers their power to its owner. I can destroy the sphere, but ghosts can disrupt my ritual. I need your help.

Tell me when to start.
r169403.n: The soul sphere attracts local ghosts, consumes them and transfers…

t:
I... I don’t know. The crystal just exploded in my hands. I've grown so weak over the centuries... But I'll think of something.

But nothing will work without a crystal. The shards are down there, on the bottom of the rift. I only have one... Take it. The shards are pulled towards each other. This shard will help you find the rest on the bottom of the rift.

To combine them into a whole crystal, you'll need extra magical energy. I sense echoes of magic among the shards on the bottom - they'll serve as a good energy source.

Go. And come back soon.
This seal is protecting my tower. No one can pass through it, not even I.
r169412.n: This seal is protecting my tower. No one can pass through it, not even…

t:
After the festivities, I left Iglez and Dinah on Yazes and went back to Umoir. That's when the new Xadaganian mage arrived - Kir... Nezeb's loyal servant. Nezeb was disturbed by the events... He heard that Urd planned to dethrone the Emperor and take his place.

Xadagan politics took a different turn then - Nezeb no longer trusted his allies in the Conclave who was there before the Cataclysm. He started replacing them with those he trusted implicitly. Kir was one of them.

Iglez didn't want Kir to get hold of Urd's belongings, so he entrusted all the notes and artifacts to me.
r169452.n: What happened to you after that victory on Yazes?

t:
Skrakan knew what happened by then. He decided to store all "forbidden" grimoires and artifacts in the same place. We picked a small city for that purpose - Veligrad.

Here we built the Tower that was later named after me. We moved all of Urd's works here. Together with my apprentices, I studied them and searched for ways to combat this dark magic.

I became an apprentice of Skrakan's... But my work completely consumed me, so I opted out of the Great Mage test. Oh, I still lived much longer than other people.

Veligrad stood strong for many years... Skrakan kept other things in the storage besides artifacts. Urd found his final rest here on Umoir - even after death, Great Mages are dangerous, and Skrakan didn't want the body of the former Soul Eater to be disturbed.

Everything changed when Leviathan gathered a horde of orcs and goblins that roamed Umoir. They rampaged through the northern lands... Al Rihat fell, followed by Veligrad. They could not withstand the attack. The storage was plundered...
r169454.n: What happened to Veligrad and Skrakan's storage?

t: What do you want to know?
r169455.n: I want to ask something else...

t:
Save the world? From what?

What are you talking about? Demons, gods... That sounds like a drunkard's tale!
r169456.n: We need the residents of Veligrad to save the world from the dark demons of the god Nihaz.

r169457.n: Why do you keep interfering with our work?

t:
Pathetic fool!

I am Galenel, a loyal apprentice and Herald of Skrakan's, the hero of Yazes who defeated the Great Mage Urd. I am the keeper of Veligrad Tower, library, and Skrakan's artifact storage!

Yes... that's right.

I was in love once... with a girl.

It was a time when Catherina brought Light to these heathen lands... We were building churches, destroying heathen temples...

Here in the Valley I met her, the beautiful blue-eyed lady...

I fell in love... our romance... was short-lived, like the last warm days before winter...

I was horrified to discover she was a witch! I had a choice - her... or my brothers and my faith.

I made my choice...

But now that my life ended in that battle in Veligrad, my soul can't find peace...
r169526.n: She and her soultakers are looking for you. She is very angry.

t: What...? Why are you stopping me? Haven't you heard what he did to me?!
Oh la la! I love my job... But that smell...
r169558.n: Oh la la! I love my job... But that smell...

t:
We set out... and ran into those who got here before us... Pirates... and Kanians with the cursed inquisitor... Cough...

It was a tough battle, we had to attack and retreat, attack and retreat... And then something terrible happened. We lost the regimental banner! Brought eternal shame upon ourselves! We all died here, but I'll never rest... unless I recover the banner!

Ahem…

I was the Colonel of the Imperial Army... My regiment was sent to Umoir five years ago when we realized what was going on there. Our scouts reported that the Blight consumed these lands...

We were hiding in the local ruins... when they told me about a powerful artifact discovered in the ruins of Veligrad.
We are the true saviors of this land. The dead shouldn't wander aimlessly - let them rest in the ground or serve the living.
r169664.n: We are the true saviors of this land. The dead shouldn't wander…

t: I see you've killed all the ghouls but haven't raised any. What am I going to tell Dakkar?
r169704.n: I see you've killed all the ghouls but haven't raised any. What am I…

t: Someday we will give Veligrad a worthy renovation. Or rebuild it.
r169832.n: Someday we will give Veligrad a worthy renovation. Or rebuild it.

t:
This door leads to the artifact storage. Powerful items and scrolls were kept there under the protection of our spells.

That was before Veligrad fell - and with it, the protection of the storage. Treasure hunters must have plundered it since then. And that bloody spirit is in there now.

If only I paid more attention to my apprentices...
r169956.n: This door leads to the artifact storage. Powerful items and scrolls…

t:
I can unveil the seals, and you must use the Soul Catcher to catch the souls bound to the seal.

Just be careful! If you touch a wrong soul, I'll be in trouble.

Try not to get me killed, alright?
r169957.n: I can unveil the seals, and you must use the Soul Catcher to catch the…

t: It’s so dark and pretty here!
r170062.n: It’s so dark and pretty here!

t: That's right. You don't know! It's a good thing I'm more given to deliberation than either you or Zayan. I can think of a favor of equal value, but I don't have time for pointless discussion. First I need to prove to my brethren that you are worthy of our trust. The decision is not solely mine to make. Nothing that will require tremendous effort on your part - just our everyday challenges.

I know why you're here. It's strange, isn't it? You live your life and close your eyes to our existence, convinced that there will never be a time when you need our help. Life is full of twists and turns. I'm aware of the kind of help you require, but what can you offer in return?

Good news. I suppose I can give you a more difficult task now. Genevieve is working on something that would allow us to face groups of armed villagers without fear. Go to her, she'll give you the details. You'd be surprised how much we've learned about cloning technology.
r170076.n: I helped Angie de Doucer. I believe the problems with food supply in Amarantha will be…

t:
I'm moving us forward! I'm in charge of artifacts, arts, and sciences. Our curse is not an excuse to stagnate.

My current interest is Gorluxor's cloning apparatus. As you can guess, we managed to grab a few when we escaped the Tower. I picked up a few things while the old man was away painting my friends in the nude.

I also have a few blood samples... not just from the humans in the village, although I secured those first. The cultists had a special bank that allowed them to revive Sarn's servants. I got hold of the bank, but it will take me a while to sort through it.

Unfortunately, there's not much time. I'm expected to provide results soon.

The world around us is cruel, and Wigo says we need to be able to defend ourselves, and this is a great opportunity to make us more powerful, even if it's dangerous. But I promise we'll be careful.

It's easier than it looks! You attach a sensor - and if you see the indicator move upward, you reduce power, and when it moves downward, increase it. Watch it for about half a minute, and it should stabilize. These devices were created by a genius, so even an idiot can use them.
r170112.n: How do I calibrate the cloning equipment?

t: I'm counting on that. Of course, we have no intention of expanding our borders, but it can help us... improve our defenses somewhat. In any case, I have a few more tasks for you - of lesser significance. Our dear Edward, the soul of Amarantha, has been out of sorts. Something caused this, and I charge you with the task of resolving it.
r170118.n: I helped Genevieve. Soon Amarantha will be able to make use of cloning equipment.

t: How dreadful! This is embarrassing! Go away, leave me alone...
r170120.n: Yes! It's all anyone is talking about!

t: The beast lives in the forest nearby, I'll mark it on the map. It should be easy to find this shapeshifter, there are rumors of a pensive and non-aggressive shapeshifter wandering the woods... The others of its kind are vicious monsters! You need to kill only this one. Well, you can kill others as well, I don't care about these creatures.

So I'll be honest, it's about love. I'm in love with Bella, a noble lady from Clear Valley...

Everything was fine until this dirty beast showed up. It must have used some kind of hypnosis to draw her attention!

I saw its tracks new her house... Anyone else would've overlooked it, but elves and vampires have an eye for these things!

I'll do anything for my love. So the task is simple - find it, kill it, and bring me its head!

Sounds reasonable... Anyway, I clearly can't deal with it myself, and I'd never share it with anyone in Amarantha, that's simply not an option! But first you must promise that no one else will find out!
r170123.n: But since it's a... delicate matter, perhaps it would be easier to discuss it with a…

t: Well, perhaps you are the best person for the job... I'll tell you everything, but you must promise that no one will hear about this!
r170124.n: Fine, everyone has the same problems - find something, kill someone. Just spit it out.

t: I'm sorry, but no... Life taught me never to trust these "jacks of all trades".
r170125.n: Yes, I'm a jack of all trades! Tell me, I'll handle everything by the end of the day.

t: You...? Well, you don't look like an expert in these matters and I've never seen you before in my life...
Aren't they sweet? So observant! But they know nothing...
r170127.n: No, no. Some people just noticed that you're sad.

r170128.n: They say you have a problem...

t: Wow, that's impressive! But why? It's not the... Ah, whatever. Give it here, I'll find some use for it. Just don't tell anyone.

Yes, yes, it's all very interesting but I have no time for chit-chat. The last assignment before we can move on to more serious matters is Abelar. He commands respect but I'm not certain whether he is... in full control of his mental faculties. His issues are likely to be a figment of his imagination, but you must go and ascertain if that's true.
r170168.n: I've dealt with Edward's problems. It was unrequited love...

t: I welcome you to our abode - Amarantha!
r170169.n: I welcome you to our abode - Amarantha!

t: You are looking at a purple mushroom. You have seen them before, but there is something unusual about this one...
r170176.n: You are looking at a purple mushroom. You have seen them before, but…

t: Oh, well great! We’ll save some antidote...
r170206.n: No, I want to stay a vampire.

t: Yes it is... Are you sure you want to be rid of it?
r170211.n: Dakkar said the vampire antidote is ready...

t: Yes, that’s all true, and I don’t like it any more than you do. But Zayan is right about one thing – this is a far lesser evil than Nihaz’s victory would be. I don’t enjoy discussing these things. If you like – talk to Zayan about it. But now you need to go to Annette. She is waiting for you by the eastern entrance.
r170214.n: But that means we're using them, even though we could put an end to their curse!

t: I’m afraid not. I proposed that idea to Zayan, but he forbids it. Annette is too strong, and if that is obvious to us, then to the vampires... She is the only one who can win their loyalty and command them.
r170215.n: Oh, what a feeling... What is our plan next? Curing Annette?

t:
And I am also here, .

The time has come to leave Avilon.

Zayan needs me as a vampire specialist. Perhaps you have already met some members of my family? Yes, the last rebellious vampires were relevant here.

So, I may prove useful.
r170217.n: Oh, you’re here! How are you?

t: Please. Have fun. Your vampirism complicates our situation a bit, but that’s no reason to give up. Now go and practice your skills. Luckily, unicorns live nearby. When you've had enough – return to me.

First – the thirst is intolerable.

Second – the thirst is not constant.

You can suppress it with the blood of animals or people. Animals are the best option, or humans who are your enemies, but be careful – if you drink the blood of the innocent, it will taint your Spark. I won’t even mention the consequences if someone notices you doing that...

Third – being a vampire has its pluses.

When you are full, you won’t just feel better, you will also possess certain... Special abilities. When you became a vampire, you acquired two natural vampire skills:  blood feast and transforming into a bat! But remember – a hungry vampire  won't manage such a difficult transformation...

There isn’t much to say – now you're a vampire, congratulations. The strange thing is how quickly it came on... We have no cure for it, as you know, so I can only advise you to strive to remain human.  However, I can tell you a couple important things.
r170220.n: Tell him about the fight with the vampire in town, the thirst and the red haze before…

t: Yes, but I‘m not a mind reader. So, tell me everything in order.
r170221.n: Zayan said you could tell me what is going on with me.

t: Don't distract me unless there is something important.
r170222.n: Don't distract me unless there is something important.

t: I didn't expect any other answer.

I understand you still have little experience controlling the dead, but it’s quite simple –  they will unquestioningly obey any order you give them.

Remember two things: they are already dead and the “life” in them is sustained through your life. That means all damage they take is redirected to you. But that also works in the reverse:  what gives them strength, also fortifies you. I doubt you’ll be able to even lift a weapon – all your concentration will go towards maneuvering the troops.

I’ll give you the best, use their powers wisely. Well, are you ready to do what must be done?

There is little time, so listen to everything right now...

We will throw our main forces into fighting the Templars on the bridge and outside the walls of the Outpost. We can’t let them take it, but some troops will probably get in!

You stay here. Urd's knowledge allows me to give you a squad of undead that will be strong enough for your mind and soul.  Try to take care of them.
r170255.n: There is little time, so listen to everything right now... We will…

t: I don't care, . Do what you must.
r170380.n: You're wrong. But I won’t tell anyone... Except Dakkar.

t:
House De Doucer. You think they are worthy of redemption? But I... I hate them! Armando killed my father... He killed everyone I knew, except Dakkar. I spent twenty long years as an undead, flying around in a coffin! Armando got off too easy for what he did to me! I want them to suffer as I have suffered!

I am Svetlana Valir, a princess and the rightful heir of my ancestors. Kania is mine by right! And I will take revenge on my enemies! If you think I’ll deny everything... you are mistaken!

Yes, I did that. I am also behind the conspiracy of the nobles! I managed to sic them on the vampires and break that alliance...
r170381.n: After all, this is your fault...

t: How can you be happy about that?! Those bloodsucking beasts are worse than Nihaz’s demons. They can only lie and betray! Hiero was supposed to deal with this problem, but even he succumbed to darkness!
r170382.n: But now, with Hiero on our side, our alliance with the vampires is possible again!

t: What a terrible siege, ... So many dead...
r170383.n: What a terrible siege, ... So many dead...

t:
Did you find it after all?! Excellent, give it here...

The principle is quite simple: if I find out how it all started, then I can figure out how to reverse it. Make her sentient again... It’s possible we could even create a universal antidote against vampirism!

Now go talk to Zayan, . We need to do something with these Templars. Now we definitely can’t lose Annette...
There is no time to waste.
r170417.n: There is no time to waste.

t: Do you realize HOW MANY draconids are on that island? We don't need another war. Our only chance is to quietly snatch the key! And quickly move it to Eclipse. After all the delays at the beginning, local intrigues and showdowns with vampires and goblins… Let’s just say we don’t have much time left. Go see Gala now. Actually... If you want to learn more about the Keys, I think you should talk to Zayan.
r170489.n: Why don't we just send a division of undead over there instead?

t:
I’d like to think we can just teleport there... And that’s exactly what we’re going to do! At first the problem was pretty obvious: no matter how strong I am, I just don't know where to teleport us, but then Gala came to my aid.

The House de Delice is famous for its portal magic, but also for the number of lovers had by its leader, Antoinette de Delice!

So Gala promised that her experimental teleporter would let me teleport right to the draconids own teleporter. I don’t know how exactly this works, but it’s our only chance.
r170490.n: But how do we get there?

t:
Silly keys... I wonder what made Nihaz create them. Alas, I know little more than you do about them. Perhaps Zayan can tell us more? If you're interested, ask him.

I don’t have time for pointless discussions. Anyway, ! Before we had to run head first into two stubborn gods, we already had two keys. The first Key was on Ferris, in that crazy Jeeg’s laboratories. You stole the second key from the wormfaces’ Temple. Both Keys were annihilated after the explosion...

They can be restored. How? I have no idea. However, you already had a chance to take part in restoring a Key. Yeah. Remember Twilight Isle, the fight with Ar’Kanim, his blood mixed with the wormface’s blood? Yes, yes, the dragons got their key then, which Lickflame was supposed to use to open the Star Gates. But who had the chance to stop him? You did!

And what happened to that key? Soliskar and Agrus took it. And only after you managed to find the dragon hunter Harat’s diary did I understand where it could be hidden. On that very island – on Heart of Fire.
r170491.n: Cosmos told me to ask you where we’re going for the Key.

r170492.n: I’m ready to go to the island.

t: The world is full of mysteries...
r170493.n: It looks like I ended up farther away than I expected after we opened the Seal... Can…

t: Ah, , glad to be back in Umoir? This is where this long story began and, apparently, this is where it will end.
r170494.n: Ah, , glad to be back in Umoir? This is where this long story began…

t: It's a magnificent structure. I know very little about it and can only see what Nihaz decided to leave in the open - factories where demons are corrupted; active time and space portals; Spark storage... If you find one, I won't be surprised if you see Sparks of certain heroes from the past inside it. Even those who are presumed gone forever.
r170703.n: What can you tell me about the Citadel?

t:
Lots of interesting things. We were wondering how a prison for a god would work. This place controls everything.

The Citadel controls Seals that keep everything in Sarnaut inside this world. When I say "everything", it means literally everything. Why was Nihaz believed to be the Zem god of death? It's simple. What do you think happens to the Sparks that "fade away"?

They go to Nihaz. To his "Box", a space where they continue to exist. There's your master of death! Where do you think he got Ath-Zak's Spark? Even Tep didn't come up with his traps on his own - he studied one of Daddy's keys.

There's more! How did Nihaz grant you your Gift of Resurrection? It's simple - at some point, Nihaz set up the Citadel in a way that the Stream of Sparks was flowing through the Purgatory he created, so they were returned to newly healed bodies. Sophisticated magic plus wicked technology - and there you have it!

After all the dealings with the Seals, the world has become rather tattered. Have you noticed that gods leave this world? They escape Sarnaut through some loophole. But we can't use it.
r170704.n: What have you learned on the storming level?

t:
Still curious about Daddy's tricks? So you must have noticed that gods and demigods sometimes "break apart". They are quite fragile, these gods - their power is too immense, so it sometimes rips them apart. But let's get back to the Servant of Tensess, who is, of course, not a servant and has absolutely nothing to do with Tensess.

This Servant is actually a soldier from that very first ship where the crew was revived for the first time. But it's not just that! The poor guy was possessed by a tiny particle of the God of Light who went crazy and started falling apart by then. And to top it all, he has a key to Sacred Blessing in his sword hilt. You gave it to him - because of your faith.

Nihaz himself never expected that chance and your blind faith would essentially create a new God of Light. The guy doesn't fully realize it himself, though. He got that blind hatred for Nihaz from Sarn... that's why he meddled in our affairs when me and Daddy toyed with Creation. For a Servant, this magic is like an alarm bell.

And he leaks power like a sieve - Sarn's fragment continues to crumble. He gave some of it to the Cradle - that's why it started spewing all these incarnations of dreams. And some went to our Claire Brightley, turning her into another slightly crazed deity of Light. She's still out there, by the way. Don't think you got rid of her permanently.
r170705.n: What have you learned on the reserve level?

t: Let's go. This goblin had an idea.

Hmm. Warfare data. Enemy movements data. Victory reports...

You know, this may seem very abstract to you, but for me... this is very personal. Alright, no time for melancholy.

You probably still have a question from the moment when Zak told you about the true revelation of Tka-Rik. What did Sarn and Nihaz disagree about? What happened that the God of Darkness was forced to capture the God of Light?

It's just a petty detail, one event among many events of the Great War. Yes, that's what we called it. It can also be called the Uprising of Nihaz. A rebel! A riot! A revolution, after all.

You know that this world isn't the only world in the universe. There are others. There are as many worlds as grains of sand on a beach of the Summer Atoll. Each world has its own gods. The gods aren't equal. They can be weak, there are patrons of savage tribes, but there are those who can create worlds. Demiurges! And even among them, there are stronger and weaker gods...

The rebellious Nihaz decided to challenge the strongest of them. He grabbed all disgruntled and threw them into the fire of his rebellion! The war lasted for millions of years. Worlds were destroyed. Gods fought. Do you remember when I said that Nihaz became something bigger? The concept of conflict? The very idea of war? Exactly!

The war still continues. Sarnaut is also involved, whether we like it or not.
r170710.n: What have you learned on the energy level?

t:
I'll hack it, but as for using it...

You won't be able to either, sorry. You need to be a Great Mage at the least. Give it to Catherina? It's dangerous, and I wouldn't want to distract her now. I have my own plans for the Queen of Umoir...

Aidenus and Yasker wouldn't do either - we don't want the League or the Empire to have a clear advantage, do we?

Well, the only candidate I can think of is Nefer Ur. He will keep everything a secret, and he is smart enough to use it wisely.

Give it to Nefer Ur - and keep quiet about what you have discovered. And I will contact you when it's time.
r170712.n: Perhaps you can hack it and give it to me?

t:
I'll try to explain.

As you already know, worlds are destroyed and rebuilt by the gods. This is part of the Great Cycle, a natural process. While creating more and more new worlds, the gods are not trying to invent anything, they have ready-made templates also known as Eidoi.

Control Cubes are sets of standard Eidoi. I don’t know how Nihaz got it, but I think he couldn’t use it.

You know that this world isn't the only world in the universe. Somewhere out there is the original world of Sarn, and in some other place you can find the world from which the Servants of Nihaz came, these funny hooded dragons.

Here in the Citadel, we gather information about all events in the world. Nihaz is on the warpath. And yes, the conflict with Sarn that gave birth to Sarnaut is only part of this Great War.

It's still going.

One of the parties were the Architects. Not so long ago, these zealots of Order turned the world into a part of the Fractal. They were unstoppable. Nihaz feared them for good reason: Darkness, Light, Life, or Death could not stand against the perfect Order.
But you and I were able to destroy the central core of this God's mind, a single person with many entities. And now the Architects outside of Sarnaut have gone mad, fighting each other.

This made it possible for all those worlds outside the astral plane to reject the enemy. They don't know who they should thank, but it's you. You managed to save lives - billions of living beings.

Of course, Nihaz also took advantage of this victory. But trust me, I have a plan to deal with him now.
r170714.n: What have you learned on the logistics level?

t:
It's not much - the coordinates of one of the worlds you will probably have to visit soon.

Not another word! Before we can use them, we still have a lot to do. And perhaps we could use the help of Catherina and the Empire. Progress can give us something the most powerful magic cannot.
r170715.n: What have you learned on the strategic level?

t: We need to banish Nihaz from this world once and for all. But it won't be easy.
r170716.n: We need to banish Nihaz from this world once and for all. But it won't…

t: We're finally here... The barrier around this level won't let us advance any further. We'll need time to understand what can be done about it.
r170717.n: We're finally here... The barrier around this level won't let us…

r170718.n: Is this Nihaz's Citadel? It's time to storm!

t: I think Nogrom has an idea on how to deal with the barrier. When you're ready, we'll start our assault.
r170719.n: I think Nogrom has an idea on how to deal with the barrier. When…

t: And I remember you, too. I can’t say those are pleasant memories.
r170726.n: I remember you from the Holy Land!

t:
That’s right. I must say these lands are much prettier that those under the gray skies of Xadagan.

I remember how they called me the Arisen-Who-Lived. I’ve had so many other names since then...

The world changes, and only one thing stays the same - idiots are fighting idiots. There’s no secret that I put my hopes on the Aoidoi.

They are way too pure and naive for war. They can put an end to this! We all should finally learn the lessons of the past.

What advice can I give you?

Our entire history, the history of the Zem people, is a search for victory over death.

Therefore, from the point of view of this... All-Mother, we are quite the heretics.

And while Catherina's and Felix's attempts to lay claim to resources in a foreign world might seem wrong, I'm afraid we have no other choice. We need technology based on the Ambrosia - with it, we'll be able to impose our will on the gods.

I see. Another world, a world where the Sparks go... Interesting.

After learning about Nihaz and Sarn, I assumed that sooner or later we would meet other gods who are just as cruel and indifferent to the interests of mortals.

But it turns out that everything that exists is the result of some goddess's actions... The goddess who wants to continue the eternal cycle of Life and Death.

I need to think about this.
r170732.n: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

t: Nefer Ur looks at you, waiting for something.
r170733.n: Nefer Ur looks at you, waiting for something.

t:
Great Astral! I barely recognized you! Back in that terrible castle you looked much less... intimidating. I wish I could listen to the stories of your adventures! All I hear recently is the news from my rivals from other Houses. The Great Ball is coming, you know. Things aren’t going that smooth in the elven community...

But let’s not talk about that!

Are you going to participate in the Games? Good to hear that! We should encourage the wonderful endeavors of this young race.

Well... you too. Let me introduce myself - Dakkar de Desirae, the prince of the House. This is my beloved wife, Svetlana Valir.

Are you going to participate in the Games? Good to hear that! We should encourage the wonderful endeavors of this young race.

Oh, I know you. You’re the hero of Dane!

I’m on my leave warrant, officially. So I can just relax without even thinking of all the military stuff. I’m from the Astralborne forces, you know. We are dropped into battle right from Astral ships! It’s fun, though usually we don’t last long. I’m a lucky long-liver, huh.

Everything is so pink and shiny. The ladies are pretty, huh.

I’m on my leave warrant, officially. So I can just relax without even thinking of all the military stuff. I’m in the Astralborne forces, you know. We are dropped into battle right from Astral ships! It’s fun, though usually we don’t last long. I’m a lucky long-liver, huh.

It must be nice to live without war. Maybe we can teach the younger generation to be friendlier...

Because if we don’t, we all just might die out one day, haha!
r170759.n: So how do you like Ammer?

t:
Oh, my daughter. Yes, the trouble is, while the father was shedding blood on the frontline, the troublemaker grew up as bold as brass.

In short, tell her I'm going to thrash her with a belt when I see her. Right there in the square. I'll show her a damn rebellion...
r170761.n: Would you like me to give a message to Fury?

t:
What?! This girl thinks too much of herself, hah.

If I see her, I'll thrash her with a belt. Right there in the square. I'll show her a damn rebellion...

What advice do you want from me?

We are the residents of Sarnaut, which means we must act in the interests of our world, and not some other.

Moreover, we don't need those who want to impose their will. We will impose our own order! The time of Trees and shamans has long passed...

Interesting! It’s a bit of a pity that I didn’t get to take part in this Expedition… But they don't trust me since I'm an orc, heh.

Felix was put in charge, and only the most reliable orcs were selected.

Therefore, I wish you success. But as a veteran, I will watch from the sidelines.
r170764.n: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

t:
Magic is power! House de Grandeur is with you now.

Complete quests on Irene under our Patronage, and you will serve our House and increase its prestige and glory! Each completed daily quest given to you by the king and his servants will count as a quest in favor of House de Grandeur. In return, your reputation with us will grow.

Gain our Patronage, and you will receive a great number of rewards:

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House.

Our House servants are crafty lamias. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Grim de Grandeur will join you. He's a young mage with very unusual ideas. He'd like to test them, and you are going to help him.

Our magic allows us to create small amounts of Dust of Creation, a unique ingredient used for crafting of powerful artifacts. We'll gladly share it with you for your loyal service to our House.
r170813.n: I want to accept House de Grandeur Patronage

t:
I'm glad to see you.

Our House is famous for the interest in magic. Magic is more than a craft for us. Magic is our whole life. Our House has the biggest number of magisters and acolytes. The main elven magic school is located on our home allod. The young mages begin their studies in a very young age. Apart from everything else, we shine in theoretical and practical magic.

Gain our Patronage, and you will receive a great number of rewards:

It's good that you decided to refresh your memory! You already have our Patronage.

By working with our House and glorifying its name, you improve your reputation with us. The better we know you, the more services and rare items we can offer.

t:
Psst, ! How about some ancient magic?

It’s a great idea - awakening these statues. They used to stand guard over the ancient kingdom, and now they’ll help us win this competition.
r170816.n: Psst, ! How about some ancient magic? It’s a great idea - awakening…

t: I want science to win this competition! So Maximilien, I guess? Though Antoinette's idea is very tempting. The world... gives scope for scientific exchange of ideas. Although, if you think about it... It's decided: House de Blizare!
r170818.n: Which House you and Albert will support?

t: Wow, such power! Perhaps these creations are the future. Living creatures will stop waging wars on each other, and statues, golems, and Mechanoids will be fighting in their stead...
r170819.n: Wow, such power! Perhaps these creations are the future. Living…

t: I see you understand the importance of magic! It's the essence of our world. And while we didn't win today, you made the right choice. Someday we'll win.
r170822.n: My vote has been cast for the House de Grandeur!

t: I am glad Antoinette has won - after all, she is our ally. I think her reign will be beneficial to all our Houses. Peace will allow us to focus on existing magical problems.
r170823.n: I am glad Antoinette has won - after all, she is our ally. I think her…

t:
I haven't decided yet.

Caspar's symphony is a great accomplishment. But if we talk about creations, it pales in comparison with everything that surrounds us. I'm talking about Galleon Castle, of course.  It's decided. House de Ardeur!

Impressive, isn't it?

True art does not need fanfares, so I didn't try to draw too much attention to my masterpiece. All these performances are nothing but pointless bustle, but this is something to remember!

Yes, thank you for your interest, but I’m not ready to show you my masterpiece. Today I’ll see what the others will offer and perhaps sign a few contracts. Besides, my cousin Hugh should arrive soon. He’s one of the Tycoons, and the loveliest ladies will accompany him... Don’t miss it!

On behalf of House de Ardeur I bless you deeds, child.

Complete quests on Irene under our Patronage, and you will serve our House and increase its prestige and glory! Each completed daily quest given to you by the king and his servants will count as a quest in favor of House de Ardeur. In return, your reputation with us will grow.
r170839.n: I want to accept House de Ardeur Patronage

t:
May the Light bless you.

House de Ardeur is one of the greatest elven Houses. We achieved much, both in glorifying the Lights and in engineering, making a fine example for other Great Houses. Mirage and Galleon Castle are our inventions. My sister Marianne and I are the Heads of the Church of Light of All Elves.

Gain our Patronage, and you will receive a great number of rewards:

A unique Ruby Gryphon of an untold beauty.

Our House servants are brave Aviaks. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Triss de Ardeur will join you. She's our youngest and most talented engineer, who will overcome Celestine one day.

We produce excellent tools for disassembling astral materials. We'll gladly share them with you for your loyal service to our House.

t: But they can't do it on their own. They need help. The dragons tried to create their own... First Priest... Lickflame Tinderbox. He was the only one that could open the Star Gates with the Key. Neither Soliskar nor Agrus can do it. Now that they're dead, the dragons are trying to create new ones... or find an ally among the Great Mages. Mages whom they deeply hate. However, strange times call for strange alliances. You know what lies ahead. I'll sign your permit.
r170843.n: Dragons want to leave Sarnaut... and return home?

t: Dragons. I've never considered them fascinating. Dragons are monsters! Heroes are supposed to kill monsters. You took down the Fiery Father also known as Sheratan. We elves know other names of dragons. Alsirr, Zuben, Nashira, Rewati, Regul, Rukbat, Sargas, Sirma, Situla, Tegmin, Elnat. Twelve Dragon Keepers. Twelve giants who tormented the world until the Junes dealt with them. Only their children survived and gave birth to all other dragons of this world. They don't really belong to this world. Dragon still hate us all. Do you realize it?
r170844.n: Ask to sign your Dragon Acquisition Permit

t: Always choose the path of the Light, my friend, and perhaps eventually you'll be able to earn my trust.
r170845.n: Always choose the path of the Light, my friend, and perhaps eventually…

t: Hello, ! Allow me to introduce House de Ardeur to you. I'm Renard de Ardeur, head of the House, and the Great Mage of the Lumenara allod.
r170846.n: Hello, ! Allow me to introduce House de Ardeur to you. I'm Renard de…

t:
I've seen a lot of beautiful but largely impractical things.

A painting? Lovely, but we have plenty of those. All palaces are covered with pictures of naked maidens and steamy scenes! A concert? I'm sorry, but I'm not a fan of ethnic music. I prefer opera. An alliance with vampires? Don't make me laugh.

So only the statue and potion remain. Both can be useful in times of war. I must decide what's more useful.

Although, Marianne here enjoyed both the music and the painting. Fine, I'll support the creator. It's decided. House de Pluie!

Ah, I see you're resorted to discrediting tactics? I have to admit, I'm impressed... I wonder how you figured that out, I could swear I left no evidence!

Well done ! You are becoming an expert in espionage. As for Marion: firstly, I deny everything, and secondly, you yourself said at the trial that vampires are not to blame. It's all Armando's fault. Thirdly, she's too good a lover.
r170852.n: I know you are seeing Marion de Doucer! And she's a vampire!

t: I hope no one expects us to abandon our plans even if Antoinette wins?
r170853.n: I hope no one expects us to abandon our plans even if Antoinette wins?

t: We were so close to victory! The thing is, if this Ball had taken place ten years ago, we would have won... The Galleon is still magnificent, but it's yesterday's news. Perhaps we should think of something new? We could continue developing the Galleon Castle's AI. She can't do much right now, but with time she might evolve into something greater.
r170856.n: I give my vote to the House de Ardeur!

t: We will win next time. And then...
r170857.n: We will win next time. And then...

It's good that you're here.

Our House servants are elegant harpies. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Aquila de Vevre will join you. She's a talented musician, who will cheer you up in your travels.

Here's your cherry on top: we found a great number of ancient artifacts, known as Moon Dragon Armor. We'll gladly share them with you for your loyal service to our House.

t:
I'm glad you've come to me.

House de Vevre is famous for its love to fine arts and music. There are a great many bards in my House. On my allod, we even have a bard academy, which provides professional education in music creation. Besides, we have excellent scouting skills. There is no secret that our oracles cannot reveal.

Gain our Patronage, and you will receive a great number of rewards:

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House.

Our House servants are elegant harpies. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Aquila de Vevre will join you. She's a talented musician, who will cheer you up in your travels.

t: That is true. I'd love to visit the world they came from. Perhaps I will! Who knows? I'm ready to sign your permit.
r170962.n: Dragons are not of this world.

t: Dragons. My people are infatuated with them. You know the history. We wanted to be like them. Many of us are still drawn to them. And Anastasia, too... I think you both have a similar appreciation for their beauty and grace. I have one of her ballads – it's about a dragon. A dragon who knows his days are numbered. Dragons don't belong in our world. Alas! Is that what you think?
r170963.n: Dragons. My people are infatuated with them. You know the history. We…

t: Hah! Do you want my signature? You know what? I'll sign it. But you have to prove your worth to my House first.
r170964.n: Hah! Do you want my signature? You know what? I'll sign it. But you…

r170965.n: , welcome to the glorious House de Vevre! I'm Caspar de Vevre, head of…

t:
Yep. See, I had to leave my small business on Eljune. I'm selling holy water!

You see, there's no saying "no" to the head of my House. It was fun. I didn't have to take care of anything. Just relaxed in the cabin while the money kept coming in. And then there were lovely pilgrims... Remember Lara? Oh...

Anyway, I've always wanted to attend the new Great Ball. I'd be happy to if I didn't need to work!
r170968.n: Louis! Been a while, hasn't it?

t: Hey, it's you, ! I've got a problem, and we need your help.
r170969.n: Hey, it's you, ! I've got a problem, and we need your help.

t: What would we do without you, ? There's nothing worse than an unfinished job just before a deadline!
r170970.n: What would we do without you, ? There's nothing worse than an…

t:
We respect House de Blizare. We share their passion to exploration and development of this world. House de Desirae are our old friends and allies, who helped us construct the Galleon Palaces. House de Pluie are our trading partners, spare parts suppliers, and supporters in spreading the teachings of the Church of Light.

Our relations with other Houses are not so light. House de Vevre are troublemakers. Too careless to rely on. House de Grandeur are incredibly arrogant, rejecting everything new in life. House de Delice... well, I don't even want to talk about them. Decadence and filth!

Every House has an exception. There's no painting them with a broad brush.
r170992.n: What do you think about the other Great Houses if I may ask?

t:
House de Ardeur is one of the greatest elven Houses. We achieved much, both in glorifying the Lights and in engineering, making a fine example for other elves. Mirage and Galleon Castle are our inventions. Our leaders, siblings Renard and Marianne, are the Heads of the Church of All Elves.

Lumenara is our allod of origin. A bright lighthouse in the astral abyss, an amber-lit shelter for everyone who wants to change this world. Thanks to Renard, all our technical innovations are on this allod, and thanks to the power of Light, it's a truly safe place. We're not alone on the Lumenara allod. The Aviak tribe, our loyal servants, defenders, and assistants inhabit this place.
r170993.n: What can you tell me about you House?

t:
After the Yazes events, I decided to dedicate myself to theoretical theology. Yes... yes! I mean the Master we came across while storming the Gorluxor's Tower. I was especially interested in his Light Side. After all the events, it's very important that we understand the essence of Tensess's Gift. The data was strictly classified, but extremely interesting!

I can send you my work when it's finished.
May the Light be with you, !
r170995.n: May the Light be with you, !

t:
Yes, you may. We're allies with House de Ardeur. They came to help on many occasions. They're our true friends. We have a connection with House de Vevre, very easygoing and fun. We share common interests in magic studies with House de Grandeur.

We lack agreement with House de Delice. What a disgrace! It's a never ending debauchery, nothing else. House de Pluie lost their honesty in business deals. And House de Desirae is too greedy for power.
r170998.n: What do you think about the other Great Houses if I may ask?

t:
Haven't you ever heard about the Great House de Blizare? Unbelievable. Alright, I'll tell you. My House is famous for our knowledge of magic, not in theory, but purely in practice. The field we shine at is alchemy. Yes, that's what I do.

Our allod Gelida is quite chilly, but thanks to our potions, we don't have any problems. It's always warm in our palaces even if a blizzard is storming outside. We share Gelida with forestfolks. We taught them many things in exchange for their eternal loyalty. They serve us now.
r170999.n: What can you tell me about you House?

t:
We're restoring Dane after the war with the architects. We put cities in order, but the north, especially the Wasp Yar, is still swarming with cultists. There's also the unfinished gate, the notorious architects' portal. Master's death locked it, but the Fractal is still active. We might need to seek Sculptor's help to control the local beasts. Although many don't trust him.

What we need is to combine our efforts. There have been so many new things lately, it makes my head spin. I want to ask Maximilien de Blizare, head of my House, for an opportunity to study the material that the architects use to create their bodies.
r171000.n: What are you up to? What are you doing on Irene?

t: Can you believe it, ? They took my alchemical bombs and fireworks at the port!
r171001.n: Can you believe it, ? They took my alchemical bombs and fireworks at…

t:
Speaking of official relations and the public opinion, here's what I have to say: House de Blizare is our ally. It's full of highly intelligent elves, pleasant to speak with. House de Delice and us have a mutual affection... as advocates of free love. Of course, there's House de Pluie that deeply appreciates our musical and other art creation.

Speaking of dislikes, we hate the way House de Ardeur is treating us! They're hypocrites, fanatics! House de Grandeur is chin-deep in their "magic research", way too deep to be an interesting company. As to House de Desirae... they've been the ruling house for so many years that they make us sick.

It's only natural that I have different kinds of relationships with members of all these Houses. I can't generalize them. Apples and oranges, you know.
r171004.n: What do you think about the other Great Houses if I may ask?

t:
About House de Vevre? Not that I'm related to it. I'm a Demon Hunter, we have our own brotherhood. On the other hand, every elf relates to their House, and the ties can't be broken. I'm sure my professional success affects my House.

Ah well. Our House is famous for fine arts. Music, mostly. There are a great many bards in my House. On my allod, we even have a bard academy, which provides professional education in music. I'm not very good at it, so I became an Oracle. But of course, music isn't our only thing. My House is full of great spies. That's where the Oracles can flourish!

Our allod Florenta is always in bloom. There are no other seasons but summer and spring. The allod is covered in flowers and bushes, the aroma is amazing, the bees are buzzing so loudly that you can't hear anything else. We also have harpies, who have been serving the House for many years. We tried to give them everything we own, and thus made them more civilized than any other harpy colony in Sarnaut.
r171005.n: What can you tell me about you House?

t:
I arrived at Irene with a group of Aoidoi from Ammer. Other than that, I've been trying to patch up a misunderstanding after Sogot events. What can I say? Nice going, Zakhar Krestov, thanks for nothing. It nearly gave a heart attack to our Hunter Commander, Negus Baruti.

I wouldn't trust the demonologists if I were you. I wonder how many of them there are among the elves.

I was going to go to Sogot after the Great Ball and try to figure out what happened. I'm especially curious about my friend's fate... August de Grandeur's.
r171006.n: What are you busy with now?

t: I have a gut feeling, ... Something big is ahead.
r171007.n: I have a gut feeling, ... Something big is ahead.

t:
House de Blizare shares our passion for knowledge. They know almost as much as we do about magic, although they're more passionate... about the practical side. We deeply respect House de Delice, which is always willing to give support. Besides, we respect House de Pluie that helps us with rare magic books and artifacts.

We treat House de Ardeur with caution. They're fanatics. Their "high-end technology" contradicts the ancient teachings of magic! House de Vevre? Too carefree. All they ever want to do is sing songs. House de Desirae members are greedy for power. They're manipulative schemers with sticky fingers.

I have friends in every House, but this has nothing to do with politics.
r171010.n: What do you think about the other Great Houses if I may ask?

t:
House de Grandeur is truly great. I can't put it in a nutshell. First of all, we're famous for our interest in magic. Magic is everything for us. We even have two Great Mages: brothers Albert and Baudouin. They govern two allods, Lightwood and Stellar. Our House has the biggest number of magisters of magic among elves!

Stellar, our main allod, is covered with a peaceful forest under a vast starry sky. The main elven magic school is located on Stellar. Elves start school in a very young age. The Lightwood allod used to belong to Kania. Today it is the residence of the Gibberlings. We help them settle down, resolve their conflicts with local forest people and Kanians, who still live on the Lightwood allod. Apart from elves, we have lamias on Stellar. We're teaching them magic. We have formed a regiment of magic support under command of a mysterious person...
r171011.n: What can you tell me about you House?

t: Oh, you know, we've returned from Howlem just recently, after they stopped hosting theatrical plays. I couldn't possibly miss the Great Ball! No way! There's a bunch of curious stuff this year. So we decided to meet on Irene. It's more fun than the boring Tenebra. Did you know that we had our own theater over here? No one knows the owner's name!
Oh, beautiful Irene! I've always wanted to visit. Just imagine the scenes I could play here, !
r171013.n: Oh, beautiful Irene! I've always wanted to visit. Just imagine the…

t:
Our king, may his name be covered in glory, supports good relations with two Houses: House de Ardeur, headed by Renard de Ardeur, who supports his policy and helps rule the elves, and House de Delice, headed by Antoinette de Delice. She's Queen Lucretia's close friend.

We're rather frosty with the other Houses. All of them, Blizare, Vever, Grandeur, and Pluie, dislike our king and his rule. They don't stand a chance of winning. You have to have the support of more than half of the other Houses, which no one has today.
r171016.n: What do you think about the other Great Houses if I may ask?

t:
Don't tell me you've never heard about us. We're famous! But alright. House de Desirae, one of the most ancient Houses, was related to the last royal House of Irene, which enabled Margo de Desirae, the mother of the king, to declare herself the queen. That was when the other Houses decided to elect the ruling House at the Great Ball. House de Desirae won several times. We connect our current success with Prince Dakkar, our king's son. He rekindled the popularity of necromancy among elves, and Conclave lifted the ban! Some unpleasant events took place after that Ball. House de Doucer, or rather, Armando, the head, was mean enough to kill the prince's bride, which was a flagrant violation of the Great Game rules. Louis de Desirae declared the House outlaws, and confiscated their home allod Nocturne.

Today House de Desirae owns two allods, the small Tenebra and the big Nocturne. Tenebra was captured by the powers of Darkness ten years, but this story is widely known. As to Nocturne, it was also influenced by Darkness. Armando's father, the Great Mage Gramon, used an incredibly powerful deadly spell during a demonic attack. It worked. The effect was so devastating that, apart from killing most demons, it took the life of the Great Mage and devastated the allod, filling it with the shadows of the dead. This is how Yoggor turned into Nocturne.

Our House's servants are Kobolds. Even death can't prevent them from fulfilling their duty.
r171017.n: What can you tell me about you House?

t:
I'm a historian. Irene is the greatest historical mystery. What do we know? The last king of Irene, Grallon, held the allod together with an extremely powerful artifact, the Key of Creation. A stranger arrived at his palace and seduced his daughter Daguta. He used her to steal the Key, and the allod started falling apart. Eventually, it was broken into shards, but didn't disappear. Why? Some say, it got into an astral bay, a quiet place, where the time flows differently. Others insist that according to an ancient legend there's a sleeping dragon under the royal palace.

In any case, I hope to study this issue. Can you help me with that?
r171018.n: What are you doing on Irene?

t: , did you know that Irene was discovered on the day when your journey began?
r171019.n: , did you know that Irene was discovered on the day when your journey…

t:
Let me tell you about the latest rumors. We're allies with House de Vevre. That's probably due to the easy attitude toward life. Both Houses are known for our... relaxed morality. We're also friends with House de Grandeur. They're open for cooperation and generous with good advice. There's, of course, House de Desirae. Queen Lucretia and Antoinette are old friends.

As to our rivals, I'd say, we lack understanding with House de Ardeur, which has become way too holy lately. We're far from agreement with House de Blizare, too. All they're thinking about is their inventions. And there's, of course, House de Pluie. The cynicism of their "business approach" is simply shocking.

Of course, this isn't my personal opinion. Common elves of the Houses may disregard the politics.
r171024.n: What do you think about the other Great Houses if I may ask?

t:
Omigod! I'm a simple historian! Don't ask me about politics. I haven't been home for ages. I have no idea what's going on. Ask someone else. Or if you're curious, I can tell you a bit about the history.

House de Delice used to be famous for its portal magic. It was common. There was next to no connection between allods after the Cataclysm. The Great Mages knew how to open temporary but very costly portals. Later, House de Delice came up with stationary portals, which were cheaper and more stable. I hear, it involved some June magic, but even so, making working spells of relocation in the chaotic astral... was not easy. Years went by. Everyone mastered the portal technology, and the glory of House de Delice began to fade. It was like this until the moment when Antoinette became the Head of the House. She placed her bet on diplomacy. We've been known as masters of negotiations ever since.

Ignis, our native allod, is a tropical atoll with an active volcano in the middle. Despite this, our land is lovely. The soil yields rich harvests, and magic protects us from dangers. Werebears are the servants of our House on Ignis. We tamed them and brought to obedience.
r171025.n: What can you tell me about you House?

t:
I've just visited a scientific conference on Nea. We discussed the final report on Junes. Yes, the studies in the Holy Land are officially completed, but my colleagues will still work there on their own accord.

And now we're heading to Ferris... perhaps. Herbert de Vevre's researchers completed some preliminary works, gathered interesting data, which needs thorough study. The only problem is the quarantine, applied by the League and Empire. I hear, they're about to lift it. The Imperials and the Gibberlings are ready to dispatch their expeditions. What are they looking for? I don't know.
r171026.n: How are you? What are you up to?

t: We're attracted to Irene by the light of the science called History, .
r171027.n: We're attracted to Irene by the light of the science called History, .

t:
My House gets along with House de Ardeur. Their chaplains are always willing to offer spiritual support and cure. They're our advocates. We appreciate House de Vevre. They share our passion to fine arts, but their field is music. House de Vevre is one of our major customers. And finally, House de Grandeur. They're also our clients, they buy ancient books and scrolls with spells.

We don't have any relations with House de Blizare. They're too arrogant and patronizing. They despise the "filthy money" and business people. House de Delice. They want everything cheap. We just can't afford doing business with them. House de Desirae has crazy taxes!

I personally can find common grounds with any elves, regardless of the House.  It would be stupid to miss opportunity, based on prejudice. Am I right?
r171031.n: What do you think about the other Great Houses if I may ask?

t:
Hah! The Great House de Pluie is natural in sales. Some say that we're too deep in business, banking, and other down to earth stuff, despised by many. There's beauty in it, believe me. Besides, House de Pluie is hosting the best artists, sculptors, and jewelers. Their works grant our superiority in the market.

The stormy Tempesta, our home allod, has harsh weather conditions. Our houses are built at a lake shore, on cliffs, but we don't care about the location: our homes are comfortable and well protected against any weather. Local minotaurs are our loyal servants. They made excellent guards for our goods.
r171032.n: What can you tell me about you House?

t:
I want to develop my project of cultural expansion of the Empire. We had great success, established delivery of smuggled goods on Igsh. There's no other option of ending this war other than imposing our vision on them! We need propaganda, which must be stronger than local agitators' and commissars' nonsense!

Our most popular and best selling item is the Pointy Ears magazine. I arrived at Irene to find new models. You know, some hot chicks! Real hellraisers!
r171033.n: What are you doing on Irene?

t: Glad to see you, . We glorified your feats by holding them up as an example for the pathetic Imperials!
r171034.n: Glad to see you, . We glorified your feats by holding them up as an…

t: You look familiar, . Where have we met? Are you the one that bought a whole lot of Pointy Ears in Nezebgrad?
r171035.n: You look familiar, . Where have we met? Are you the one that bought a…

t:
It's good that you decided to refresh your memory! You already have our Patronage.

By working with our House and glorifying its name, you improve your reputation with us. The better we know you, the more services and rare items we can offer.

First of all, beautiful outfits in the colors of our House.

Our House servants are skilled mountainfolk. You can have one of them as your companion.

Once you earn a friendly reputation with us, Rosan de Blizare will join you. He's a talented alchemist, who will gain his combat experience with you.

Besides, we know how to synthesize the Unsteady Matter, which will come in handy if you want to reforge your armor. We'll gladly share it with you for your loyal service to our House.
r171045.n: What will I gain from the Patronage of House de Blizare?

t: I agree with you. We have a theory that the entire Universe with all the worlds in it is ruled by these Powers: Creation and Destruction, Life and Death. Two sides of a coin, and neither exists without the other. You understand the nature of things. I'll sign your permit.
r171047.n: Perhaps they embody the eternal powers of Creation and Destruction.

t: Dragon blood holds this world's greatest power! The power that allowed us to stop the astral. As an alchemist, I have spent years studying this substance. A long time ago we came to understand that their power... is not of this world. Just like the power of the Great Trees. They have a lot of things in common, but many things are different. Dragon Flame is the ideal eradicator. It destroys even non-combustible things. Great Tree saplings are strong enough to create new matter from the Astral. What do you think?
r171048.n: Dragon blood holds this world's greatest power! The power that allowed…

t: My friend, you've done so little. Unfortunately, I can't trust you.
r171049.n: My friend, you've done so little. Unfortunately, I can't trust you.

t:
On behalf of the House de Blizare, I welcome you, ! I'm Maximilien de Blizare, the head of this House and the Great Mage of Gelida allod.

On behalf of the House de Blizare, I'd like to thank you for helping me with my great scientific experiment.
r171050.n: On behalf of the House de Blizare, I welcome you, ! I'm Maximilien de…

t: Anyone can pick up the bugle and play! You just need to blow hard!
r171065.n: Your instrument is an important part of the symphony!

t: Yes, the First say you need to fight fear... I believe you’re right, eysh. I can’t let my ancestors and my people down. I’ll overcome my fear and go back. But... I’m lost and can’t find Caspar... Will you take me?
r171068.n: Is that what Howlem spirits teach? Faltering in the face of fear?

t: Your words are nice, but they don’t touch my heart, because we are strangers to each other. Your belief in me does not awaken my own belief.
r171069.n: You can do it, Tamira Windsong! I believe in you!

t: I understand... But I’m afraid I’ll disappoint him, you, and the audience, eysh... I just can’t...
r171070.n: Caspar picked you for your spirit!

t: Any Priden can learn to play the bugle! They teach us when we’re just cubs... So everyone on Howlem knows this tune!
r171071.n: There’s no time to teach a new musician. You have training!

t: There are many Pridens! Ask any of them! Anyone will agree if you ask them!
r171072.n: You are representing a Priden tribe, the band won’t be complete without you.

t:
Listen... When I saw all these important people, I got scared... Now I’m afraid to go there... And perform? I feel nervous! I can’t breathe!

I believe the band can do without me! I’m sorry.
r171073.n: What are you doing here? Caspar is looking for you.

t: I don’t doubt it! We rehearsed for days. I hope no one gets the jitters before the show.

Welcome to the Great Ball, !

Soon the most beautiful thing in existence will fill these halls - music!

I hope everyone is ready?
r171097.n: Welcome to the Great Ball, ! Soon the most beautiful thing in…

t: I was quite impressed by this trial... And the vampires' sacrifice! I already started composing a new symphony, or rather, an opera about the tragic story of their fate! I liked a lot of things: Galleon Castle, Guillaume's painting... But I'll probably support Antoinette. It's decided. House de Delice!
No one had any doubts about it. My wards gave it their all. I believe we should do it again. Interracial orchestras are the future!
r171100.n: It was a very interesting performance!
